item.aggregated_output:
---
title: "Yeh Bait E Fatima Hai"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Manqabat"
poet: "Ali"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Yeh Bait e Fatima Hai Yeh Baab e Qabool Hai Dr Syed Ali Abbas Rizvi.
Iss Dar Pe Qudsiyoon Ka Musalsal Nazool Hai.
Had-e-Adab Hai Fatima Zahra Ke Baab Mein.
Aankhon Ke Sath Dil Bhi Jhukay Yeh Usool Hai.

2
Zahra Ke Dar Ko Chor Ke Janat Mein Jao Gay.
Jo Bhi Yeh Sochta Hai Tu Oss Ki Yeh Bhool Hai.
Zahra Uthaein Hath Dua Ke Liye Tu Phir.
Darzi Ka Martaba Bhi Malak Ko Qabool Hai.

3
ALLAH Re Hussain Ki Madar Ki Azmatein.
Har Baat Syeda Ki Khuda Ko Qabool Hai.
Jis Rastay Se Jati Hain Masjid Ko Fatima.
Oss Rah Mein Tu Paon Ka Kanta Bhi Phool Hai.

4
Pohanchay Na Ja Ke Jo Dar-e-Bint-e-Rasool Tak.
Hum Ko Woh Rasta Na Woh Manzil Qabool Hai.
Midhat Hai Fatima Ki Faqat Iss Liye Ali.
Maqsad Mera Riza-e-Khuda Ka Hasool Hai.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/yeh-bait-e-fatima-hai-tajpoints-72a1beddfd1c2cf4434d.md')
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')]:
    blocks = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 4
    for block, number in zip(blocks, numbers):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        assert lines[0].strip() == number and len(lines) == 5
        assert all(not line.endswith('.') for line in lines[1:])
print('Both editions have four matching stanzas of four verses each.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu body and preserved the Roman verse wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions have four stanzas of four verses each. I added the Urdu title, set the direction to RTL, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read “Malak” as مَلَک (“angel”) and treated the full name appended to the opening line as attribution outside the verse. Only the selected Markdown file changed.
